noise_model_note: Glider tail numbers are listed for completeness but are silent and cannot generate noise events. Published fleet description: ~11x Cessna 172S (NavII / NavIII G1000), 1x Cessna 182T G1000, 1x Piper PA-28R Arrow, 2x Piper PA-44-180 Seminole, plus Redbird MCX and Frasca TruFlite sims. The 15 confirmed Cessna 172S tails closely match the published 11x C172S count (extras may be recent additions). Spartan Flight Academy (Part 61) is a related but separate brand. Note: 'Spartan College of Aeronautics & Technology — Denver/Broomfield' at 10851 W 120th Ave is the A&P aviation maintenance school under the same parent — its on-campus C152/C172/Learjet/Falcon airframes are ground trainers, not flight-school operating aircraft. **Fleet-naming convention (user-confirmed 2026-06-01): any tail with an `SF` or `FF` suffix in the KBJC area is a McAir / Spartan aircraft.** Server-side `resolvePurpose` (or the client-side school index) should treat the regex `^N\d+(SF|FF)$` as a McAir/Spartan match when the type is C172/C152/P28A/PA28 and the home airport reads KBJC. SF-suffix (N256SF / N265SF) and FF-suffix (N58FF / N79FF) tails explicitly listed above were the four flagged in 2026-06-01 listener-traffic analysis; any other matching tail picked up by traffic in the future is the same operator and should be auto-attributed.
